reference_sql:
WITH b AS (SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS bliksem_min_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Bliksem' AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY product_id),
s AS (SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS stroomhuis_min_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Stroomhuis' AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY product_id)
SELECT COALESCE(b.product_id, s.product_id) AS product_id, b.bliksem_min_eur, s.stroomhuis_min_eur
FROM b
FULL OUTER JOIN s ON s.product_id = b.product_id
alternatives: SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) FILTER (WHERE competitor = 'Bliksem') AS bliksem_min_eur, MIN(price_eur) FILTER (WHERE competitor = 'Stroomhuis') AS stroomhuis_min_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' AND competitor IN ('Bliksem', 'Stroomhuis') GROUP BY product_id

WITH b AS (SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS bliksem_min_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Bliksem' AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS stroomhuis_min_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Stroomhuis' AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY product_id) SELECT COALESCE(s.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id, b.bliksem_min_eur, s.stroomhuis_min_eur FROM s FULL JOIN b ON b.product_id = s.product_id

other_way.sql: SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) FILTER (WHERE competitor = 'Bliksem') AS bliksem_min_eur, MIN(price_eur) FILTER (WHERE competitor = 'Stroomhuis') AS stroomhuis_min_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' AND competitor IN ('Bliksem', 'Stroomhuis') GROUP BY product_id
other_way.tradeoff: One GROUP BY with FILTER is shorter for two rivals in one table, but FULL OUTER JOIN also reconciles lists from different tables.

solver.query:
SELECT product_id,
       MIN(CASE WHEN competitor = 'Bliksem' THEN price_eur END) AS bliksem_min_eur,
       MIN(CASE WHEN competitor = 'Stroomhuis' THEN price_eur END) AS stroomhuis_min_eur
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE competitor IN ('Bliksem', 'Stroomhuis')
  AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
GROUP BY product_id
